question: If the mode of the data 12, 9, 10, 12, 13, (2K - 2), 13, 19, 15, and 17 is 12, find the value of K.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mode = 12 ⇒ it must appear maximum times

Already 12 appears 2 times

So (2K − 2) must also be 12 to increase frequency

2K − 2 = 12 ⇒ 2K = 14 ⇒ K = 7

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data: 12, 9, 10, 12, 13, (2K − 2), 13, 19, 15, 17

Mode = 12

**Formula used:**

Mode = Most frequently occurring value

**Calculation:**

⇒ Frequency of 12 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 13 = 2

⇒ To make 12 the mode, its frequency must increase

⇒ So (2K − 2) = 12

⇒ 2K − 2 = 12

⇒ 2K = 14

⇒ K = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mode Definition

Mode is the value that occurs most frequently in a dataset

Frequency Concept

Count occurrences of each value to identify mode

Tie Case

If two values have same frequency, no unique mode exists

Key Insight

Adjust unknown term to maximize frequency of given mode
